items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: He used to go to Walter Pichon on the boat.

ctx.x: Which Humphrey is that? It went out for him grab call. I had to take letters from the grab call. Oh yeah, you mentioned that. Is that Jim Humphrey? The old man Jim Humphrey. Oh yeah. If you want to stop at any time we can't have a phone lines or anything. We can't. Okay. Okay. You see that a lot of people playing music? Uh huh.

Yeah, my brother was playing. Bill Kazma, one of the best talent players they had. He used to go to Walter Pichon on the boat. And uh, quite a lot of you out there, they go playing every night. I'm not playing. Bill Kazma, they played a ton of slacks.
That's up in Chicago, man. Chicago, yeah.
